name: Subarray Sum Equals K
description: Counts subarrays with sum exactly equal to k using prefix sums and a hash map for O(n) time.
aim: Count subarrays summing to k: track prefix sums and use a hash map to find how many previous prefix sums equal (current - k).
howItWorks: At each index i: if prefixSum-k was seen before, those subarrays sum to k
Use map: prefixSum → count of times seen
Initialize map with {0:1} for subarrays starting at index 0

realWorld: Financial analysis: find periods with specific total
Network traffic: windows summing to threshold
alternatives: Sliding window — only works for non-negative arrays

inputHint: The LAST number is the target sum k; the array is everything before it.
